Read the original benchmark description; the later version was available before the evaluation date and is used instead.

evidence_items.explanation: The study reports persistent difficulties in narrative understanding and improvements when relevant visual content is selected. It does not establish the complete capability required for early contradiction, and its results cannot settle performance in 2029.
